full_sentence: Because the bus was late, we missed the start of the film.
acceptable_variants: we arrived after the movie had begun.
we had to wait for the next show.

options.why_wrong: This does not follow from the bus being late. The cause and effect link is missing.

options.text: the cinema was closed on Sundays.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact and is not a result of the bus being late.

options.text: we missed the start of the film.

options.why_wrong: This describes the film itself, not a result of the late bus.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause, so the main clause must give the result of that cause. A late bus leads to arriving late and missing part of the event.
translation: Como el autobús llegó tarde, nos perdimos el inicio de la película.
